column62: 1740 +5/−4 Ma (U-Pb baddeleyite; Irving et al., 2004). A modified York regression of four baddeleyite fractions from a thick Cleaver dyke at Conjuror Bay (sample SSG-00-51) gives an upper-intercept age interpreted as the crystallization age of the dyke and, by their consistent field characteristics and magnetization directions, of the Cleaver swarm as a whole. The nominal age adopted here is 1740 Ma (1736–1745 Ma).
